definition: to see things while you are asleep
description: Inside a train carriage at night, a young man with a beard, a denim shirt and a white T-shirt sits fast asleep in his seat with his eyes closed and a happy smile, waving both arms high in the air as if cheering. A sandwich and a paper coffee cup sit on the table in front of him. Other passengers watch, amused, and a woman covers her mouth. A small brown dog in the aisle moves up to the table and sniffs at the sandwich, and lights streak past the window.

en.question: What is the sleeping man doing?

de.answer: Er winkt im Schlaf mit den Armen.
de.question: Was macht der schlafende Mann?

es.answer: Está agitando los brazos en sueños.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre dormido?

fr.answer: Il agite les bras dans son sommeil.
phrases: pousser des cris de joie dans son sommeil
